messages:
maria_p: Heads-up — submitted an offer for L4 SWE in EU remote. Hiring manager asked to move candidate to band L5 due to senior IC expectations and to add a one-time relocation/settlement bump even though they're remote. Need approvals + confirm earlier start date request (candidate asked to start 2 weeks earlier).
aj_recruiter: Can you paste the numbers and justification? I already told the candidate we need comp committee sign-off.
maria_p: Sure — current template offer is `Base: $140,000 (EUR equiv) | Bonus: 10% | Equity: 0.15%`. Requesting `Base: $165,000` and `Sign-on: $8,000` (one-time). Rationale: proven infra ownership, will lead critical init project, market comps ~L5 in EU remote.
dave_h: +1 from me. They've run infra at scale and will replace two roles. We need them earlier because of Q3 deliverable. If band is bumped, we can justify with scope & short-term impact.
katie_fin: Quick Qs — is the total comp above our hard cap for L5 in that region? Also need cost forecast for FY and headcount planning impact.
maria_p: I checked comps table — `L5 cap (EU remote): $180k base` so base fits within L5 cap. FY delta vs budget: +$25k base + $8k sign-on = ~$33k incremental first year. I can add lines to the approval ticket with P&L impact.
sam_eng: Benefits question — if we change band to L5 and move start earlier, when does their 401k/retirement and health coverage kick in? Need to confirm eligibility window.
katie_fin: Good call. Benefits transition runs on start-of-month rule for EU contractors we use? For full-time headcount we do first of month after 30 days. Need final start date to advise payroll.
maria_p: Candidate asked to start on `2026-05-04` (two weeks earlier than our usual `2026-05-18`). If approved, payroll onboarding team needs final by next Tue.
aj_recruiter: I'll ping the candidate to hold that earlier date as tentative until approvals done.
maria_p: Routing suggestion: 1) submit comp-exception to Comp Committee with justification + manager sign-off, 2) finance to ack P&L delta, 3) people-ops to confirm benefits kick-in and payroll timeline, 4) final approval recorded and offer updated.
dave_h: Happy to add a 1-paragraph business case in the ticket.
katie_fin: I'll review P&L and backchannel if we need to escalate to CFO for headcount changes.
offer-bot: Approval ticket created: COMP-2026-4827. Link: https://redwood.internal/comp/COMP-2026-4827 
maria_p: Putting docs in the ticket: candidate CV, hiring note, comps snapshot, FY impact calc. cc @katie_fin @dave_h @aj_recruiter
aj_recruiter: Thanks — candidate is holding the earlier date but asked about benefits/visa timeline. I'll include that in the ticket.
maria_p: If committee approves today we can send revised offer by EOD and confirm start as `2026-05-04`. If not, offer will default to `2026-05-18`. Please react with :+1: if you approve routing and contents.
dave_h: :+1:
katie_fin: :+1:
sam_eng: :+1:
aj_recruiter: :+1:
